visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with dyed brown hair and spectacles, dressed in a black short-sleeved t-shirt and black trousers, stands in a weathered outdoor parking lot overgrown with tall grass and weeds. He talks enthusiastically to the camera, using wide arm movements and expressive hand gestures to recount a story about his ant-infested car. Several neglected vehicles are visible in the background, including a white SUV and a damaged grey sedan, under bright, natural daylight. (2) The camera moves to a closer shot as the man holds a blue, white, and silver aerosol can, clearly displaying the 'Crocodile' brand logo and Traditional Chinese text. He points to the can with his right hand while maintaining high energy. Graphic variety text in yellow and purple pops up on screen to emphasize his points. (3) The man is joined by a young woman with long dark hair wearing an oversized purple t-shirt and white sneakers. They stand beside a white hatchback car in the overgrown lot. The woman cautiously opens the driver-side door while the man reacts with a look of mock horror. (4) Close-up shots focus on the car's exterior, specifically the hood and door seals, where numerous small black ants are seen crawling over the white paint and among dry brown leaves. (5) The man sits in the driver's seat of the car and presses the nozzle of the aerosol can, releasing a thick white chemical mist that fills the front cabin. He quickly exits and closes the door. (6) A series of instructional graphics appear over a blurred background, showing the man demonstrating how to shake the can. The 'Crocodile' product line is then showcased with professional studio lighting, listing features like '99.9% antibacterial' in bold text overlays. (7) Returning to the car, the man opens the door and leans into the interior. He points to several dead ants and small insects scattered across the black floor mats and seats. He looks directly at the camera with a satisfied smile and a thumbs-up gesture. (8) The video concludes with the man holding the product can one last time in the outdoor setting, gesturing towards the car and smiling brightly as final variety captions appear.

The main speaker exclaims with a high-pitched 'Oh!', indicating surprise. The BGM continues steadily underneath. narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the 'Crocodile' brand car insect and sanitizer spray by demonstrating its effectiveness in a real-world scenario where a car has been infested by ants. The video uses a mix of humor, casual vlogging, and professional product shots to build trust and encourage purchase.
